sources.title: BennyDaBall/Qwen-Image-2.1-NVFP4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is an independent NVFP4 quantization of Qwen Image 2.1. The Qwen team created the original model. The original model and architecture are Qwen's work. I converted the official Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image-2.1 BF16 checkpoint package and packaged the quantized weights, workflows, and validation here ...

sources.title: BennyDaBall-Qwen-Image-2.1-NVFP4 · Models
sources.snippet: The image model AND the text encoder. 12.42 GB for the complete package. I converted Qwen Image 2.1's image transformer and Qwen3-VL 8B language encoder directly from the official BF16 weights into native ComfyUI NVFP4.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo - QwenCloud
sources.snippet: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is the most balanced and cost-effective open-source image generation model currently available in the Qwen-Image series. Qwen-Image-2.1 offers four key strengths: Compact Model, Strong Performance, Exceptional Value. Native Transparency, Unified Generation and Editing.

sources.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo: 8 Steps, 7B, How to Run It - explainx.ai
sources.snippet: What exactly did Qwen release? The model card describes Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo as "an accelerated checkpoint of Qwen-Image-2.1 for text-to-image generation and image editing with 8 denoising steps." It is not a new architecture and not a new training run announced as a successor; it is the same 7B visual generator distilled or tuned for a short sampling schedule.
